videos.title: AI Debt Is Exploding — Is Another Fed Bailout Coming?
videos.description:
In this Short video, Cem Karsan and Adam Taggart discuss a dangerous combination of forces building in the bond market: a massive debt refinancing wave, persistent inflation, and an increasingly debt-financed AI infrastructure boom. 

Together, these pressures could trigger a major credit crisis and eventually force the Fed to intervene.

*

The first problem is the refinancing wall.

In 2021, governments, corporations, and municipalities borrowed enormous amounts of money at near-zero interest rates, often with maturities of five to seven years.
